answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Observatory transit log countersigned by the royal astronomer, priced at each log is a transit observed and signed by the royal astronomer, so a farm must. Faking 754 identities means 754 fresh proofs and 89 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 16 minutes. Judge it by the quill: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the beacon: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the lantern: a file that outlives the farm. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
